rows.name: AllowShortBlocksOnASingleLine
rows.description: 短代码块保留单行的规则。

rows.description: 短case 表达式保留单行的规则。
rows.originalDescription: Whether to merge a short switch labeled rule into a single line.

rows.originalDescription: If true, short case labels will be contracted to a single line.

rows.name: AllowShortFunctionsOnASingleLine

rows.name: AllowShortIfStatementsOnASingleLine
rows.description: 短if 语句保留单行的规则。

rows.name: AllowShortLambdasOnASingleLine

rows.originalDescription: Dependent on the value, auto lambda []() { return 0; } can be put on a single line.

rows.name: AllowShortLoopsOnASingleLine

rows.name: AllowShortNamespacesOnASingleLine

rows.name: IndentWrappedFunctionNames

rows.originalDescription: Indent if a function definition or declaration is wrapped after the type.

rows.name: InsertBraces
rows.description: 为控制语句插入花括号；该转换不进行完整语义分析。
rows.originalDescription: Insert braces after control statements (if, else, for, do, and while) in C++ unless the control statements are inside macro definitions or the braces would enclose preprocessor directives.

rows.name: InsertNewlineAtEOF
rows.description: 是否保证文件末尾存在换行符。
rows.originalDescription: Insert a newline at end of file if missing.

rows.name: InsertTrailingCommas
rows.description: 尾随逗号的插入规则。
rows.originalDescription: If set to TCS_Wrapped will insert trailing commas in container literals (arrays and objects) that wrap across multiple lines. It is currently only available for JavaScript and disabled by default TCS_None. InsertTrailingCommas cannot be used together with BinPackArguments as inserting the comma disables bin-packing.

rows.name: JavaImportGroups
rows.description: Java 导入分组规则。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: A vector of prefixes ordered by the desired groups for Java imports.

rows.name: JavaScriptQuotes
rows.description: JavaScript 引号风格。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: The JavaScriptQuoteStyle to use for JavaScript strings.

rows.name: JavaScriptWrapImports
rows.description: JavaScript 导入是否换行。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: Whether to wrap JavaScript import/export statements.

rows.name: KeepEmptyLines
rows.values: JSON 对象；兼容形式以插件校验为准。
rows.description: 控制文件开头、块开头和文件末尾等位置的空行保留。
rows.originalDescription: Which empty lines are kept. See MaxEmptyLinesToKeep for how many consecutive empty lines are kept.

rows.name: KeepEmptyLines.AtEndOfFile
rows.description: 保留文件末尾空行。
rows.originalDescription: 保留文件末尾空行。

rows.name: KeepEmptyLines.AtStartOfBlock
rows.description: 保留代码块开头空行。
rows.originalDescription: 保留代码块开头空行。

rows.name: KeepEmptyLines.AtStartOfFile
rows.description: 保留文件开头空行。
rows.originalDescription: 保留文件开头空行。

rows.name: KeepEmptyLinesAtEOF
rows.description: 是否保留文件末尾空行；旧版兼容选项。
rows.originalDescription: This option is **deprecated**. See AtEndOfFile of KeepEmptyLines.

rows.name: KeepEmptyLinesAtTheStartOfBlocks
rows.description: 是否保留代码块开头空行；旧版兼容选项。
rows.originalDescription: This option is **deprecated**. See AtStartOfBlock of KeepEmptyLines.

rows.name: KeepFormFeed
rows.description: 是否保留换页符。
rows.originalDescription: Keep the form feed character if it's immediately preceded and followed by a newline. Multiple form feeds and newlines within a whitespace range are replaced with a single newline and form feed followed by the remaining newlines.

rows.name: LambdaBodyIndentation
rows.description: Lambda 函数体相对 Lambda 签名还是外层作用域缩进。
rows.originalDescription: The indentation style of lambda bodies. Signature (the default) causes the lambda body to be indented one additional level relative to the indentation level of the signature. OuterScope forces the lambda body to be indented one additional level relative to the parent scope containing the lambda signature.

rows.name: LineEnding
rows.description: 换行符使用 LF、CRLF，或从输入推断。
rows.originalDescription: Line ending style (\n or \r\n) to use.

rows.name: MacroBlockBegin
rows.description: 识别宏代码块开始的正则表达式。
rows.originalDescription: A regular expression matching macros that start a block.

rows.name: MacroBlockEnd
rows.description: 识别宏代码块结束的正则表达式。
rows.originalDescription: A regular expression matching macros that end a block.

rows.name: Macros
rows.description: 宏定义字符串数组，供格式化器识别宏展开形态。
rows.originalDescription: A list of macros of the form <definition>=<expansion> .

rows.name: MacrosSkippedByRemoveParentheses
rows.description: 移除冗余括号时应跳过的宏名称数组。
rows.originalDescription: A vector of function-like macros whose invocations should be skipped by RemoveParentheses.

rows.name: MainIncludeChar
rows.description: 主头文件采用双引号还是尖括号匹配。
rows.originalDescription: When guessing whether a #include is the "main" include, only the include directives that use the specified character are considered.

rows.name: MaxEmptyLinesToKeep
rows.description: 连续空行最多保留的数量。
rows.originalDescription: The maximum number of consecutive empty lines to keep.

rows.name: NamespaceIndentation
rows.description: 命名空间内容的缩进规则。
rows.originalDescription: The indentation used for namespaces.

rows.name: NamespaceMacros
rows.description: 应按命名空间结构处理的宏名称数组。
rows.originalDescription: A vector of macros which are used to open namespace blocks.

rows.name: ObjCBinPackProtocolList
rows.description: Objective-C 协议列表的紧凑排列。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: Controls bin-packing Objective-C protocol conformance list items into as few lines as possible when they go over ColumnLimit.

rows.name: ObjCBlockIndentWidth
rows.description: Objective-C 块的缩进宽度。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: The number of characters to use for indentation of ObjC blocks.

rows.name: ObjCBreakBeforeNestedBlockParam
rows.description: Objective-C 嵌套块参数前是否换行。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: Break parameters list into lines when there is nested block parameters in a function call.

rows.name: ObjCPropertyAttributeOrder
rows.description: Objective-C 属性特性的排序。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: The order in which ObjC property attributes should appear.

rows.name: ObjCSpaceAfterProperty
rows.description: Objective-C @property 后是否加入空格。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: Add a space after @property in Objective-C, i.e. use @property (readonly) instead of @property(readonly).

rows.name: ObjCSpaceBeforeProtocolList
rows.description: Objective-C 协议列表前是否加入空格。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: Add a space in front of an Objective-C protocol list, i.e. use Foo <Protocol> instead of Foo<Protocol>.

rows.name: OneLineFormatOffRegex
rows.description: 匹配应跳过格式化的整行的正则表达式。
rows.originalDescription: A regular expression that describes markers for turning formatting off for one line. If it matches a comment that is the only token of a line, clang-format skips the comment and the next line. Otherwise, clang-format skips lines containing a matched token.

rows.name: PPIndentWidth
rows.description: 预处理指令的缩进宽度。
rows.originalDescription: The number of columns to use for indentation of preprocessor statements. When set to -1 (default) IndentWidth is used also for preprocessor statements.

rows.name: PackConstructorInitializers
rows.description: 构造初始化项的紧凑排列策略。
rows.originalDescription: The pack constructor initializers style to use.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakAssignment
rows.description: 赋值运算符的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking around an assignment operator.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakBeforeFirstCallParameter
rows.description: 第一个调用实参之前的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking a function call after call(.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakBeforeMemberAccess
rows.description: 成员访问之前的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking before a member access operator (., ->).

rows.name: PenaltyBreakComment
rows.description: 注释的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for each line break introduced inside a comment.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakFirstLessLess
rows.description: 第一个 << 运算符的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking before the first <<.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakOpenParenthesis
rows.description: 左圆括号的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking after (.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakScopeResolution
rows.description: 作用域运算符的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking after ::.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakString
rows.description: 字符串的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for each line break introduced inside a string literal.

rows.name: PenaltyBreakTemplateDeclaration
rows.description: 模板声明的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for breaking after template declaration.

rows.name: PenaltyExcessCharacter
rows.description: 超过列宽的字符的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: The penalty for each character outside of the column limit.

rows.name: PenaltyIndentedWhitespace
rows.description: 缩进空格的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: Penalty for each character of whitespace indentation (counted relative to leading non-whitespace column).

rows.name: PenaltyReturnTypeOnItsOwnLine
rows.description: 返回类型独占一行的惩罚值；数值越大越不倾向采用该布局。
rows.originalDescription: Penalty for putting the return type of a function onto its own line.

rows.name: PointerAlignment
rows.description: 指针符号 * 靠近类型、变量名，还是居中。
rows.originalDescription: Pointer and reference alignment style.

rows.name: QualifierAlignment
rows.description: const 等限定符的位置规则；调整顺序可能影响语义，应谨慎使用。
rows.originalDescription: Different ways to arrange specifiers and qualifiers (e.g. const/volatile).

rows.name: RawStringFormats
rows.description: 原始字符串内容的语言、分隔符和格式规则数组。
rows.originalDescription: Defines hints for detecting supported languages code blocks in raw strings.

rows.name: ReferenceAlignment
rows.description: 引用符号 & 的对齐规则，可跟随指针对齐。
rows.originalDescription: Reference alignment style (overrides PointerAlignment for references).

rows.name: ReflowComments
rows.description: 注释是否重排以符合行宽。
rows.originalDescription: Comment reformatting style.

rows.name: RemoveBracesLLVM
rows.description: 移除符合 LLVM 风格的多余花括号；可能改变源码结构。
rows.originalDescription: Remove optional braces of control statements (if, else, for, and while) in C++ according to the LLVM coding style.

rows.name: RemoveEmptyLinesInUnwrappedLines
rows.description: 是否移除未换行语句内部的空行。
rows.originalDescription: Remove empty lines within unwrapped lines.

rows.name: RemoveParentheses
rows.description: 冗余圆括号的移除规则。
rows.originalDescription: Remove redundant parentheses.

rows.name: RemoveSemicolon
rows.description: 是否移除函数或构造定义后多余的分号。
rows.originalDescription: Remove semicolons after the closing braces of functions and constructors/destructors.

rows.name: RequiresClausePosition
rows.description: requires 子句的排列位置。
rows.originalDescription: The position of the requires clause.

rows.name: RequiresExpressionIndentation
rows.description: requires 表达式内容相对外层作用域还是关键字缩进。
rows.originalDescription: The indentation used for requires expression bodies.

rows.name: SeparateDefinitionBlocks
rows.description: 函数、类等定义之间是否保留、插入或移除空行。
rows.originalDescription: Specifies the use of empty lines to separate definition blocks, including classes, structs, enums, and functions.

rows.name: ShortNamespaceLines
rows.description: 命名空间最多多少行时省略末尾命名空间注释。
rows.originalDescription: The maximal number of unwrapped lines that a short namespace spans. Defaults to 1.

rows.name: SkipMacroDefinitionBody
rows.description: 是否跳过宏定义内容的格式化。
rows.originalDescription: Do not format macro definition body.

rows.name: SortIncludes
rows.values: JSON 对象；兼容形式以插件校验为准。
rows.description: include 排序及是否区分大小写等规则。
rows.originalDescription: Controls if and how clang-format will sort #includes.

rows.name: SortIncludes.Enabled
rows.description: 启用此规则。
rows.originalDescription: 启用此规则。

rows.name: SortIncludes.IgnoreCase
rows.description: 排序时忽略大小写。
rows.originalDescription: 排序时忽略大小写。

rows.name: SortIncludes.IgnoreExtension
rows.description: 排序时忽略文件扩展名。
rows.originalDescription: 排序时忽略文件扩展名。

rows.name: SortJavaStaticImport
rows.description: Java 静态导入位于普通导入之前还是之后。此选项用于其他 LLVM 支持的语言，不影响本软件的 C/C++ 格式化。
rows.originalDescription: When sorting Java imports, by default static imports are placed before non-static imports. If JavaStaticImportAfterImport is After, static imports are placed after non-static imports.

rows.name: SortUsingDeclarations
rows.description: using 声明的排序规则。
rows.originalDescription: Controls if and how clang-format will sort using declarations.

rows.name: SpaceAfterCStyleCast
rows.description: 是否在C 风格类型转换之后添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, a space is inserted after C style casts.

rows.name: SpaceAfterLogicalNot
rows.description: 是否在逻辑非运算符 !之后添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, a space is inserted after the logical not operator (!).

rows.name: SpaceAfterOperatorKeyword
rows.description: 是否在operator 关键字之后添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, a space will be inserted after the operator keyword.

rows.name: SpaceAfterTemplateKeyword
rows.description: 是否在template 关键字之后添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, a space will be inserted after the template keyword.

rows.name: SpaceAroundPointerQualifiers
rows.description: 指针限定符前后的空格规则。
rows.originalDescription: Defines in which cases to put a space before or after pointer qualifiers

rows.name: SpaceBeforeAssignmentOperators
rows.description: 是否在赋值运算符之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If false, spaces will be removed before assignment operators.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeCaseColon
rows.description: 是否在case 冒号之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If false, spaces will be removed before case colon.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeCpp11BracedList
rows.description: 是否在C++11 花括号初始化列表之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, a space will be inserted before a C++11 braced list used to initialize an object (after the preceding identifier or type).

rows.name: SpaceBeforeCtorInitializerColon
rows.description: 是否在构造初始化冒号之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If false, spaces will be removed before constructor initializer colon.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeInheritanceColon
rows.description: 是否在继承冒号之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If false, spaces will be removed before inheritance colon.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeJsonColon
rows.description: 是否在JSON 冒号之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, a space will be added before a JSON colon. For other languages, e.g. JavaScript, use SpacesInContainerLiterals instead.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParens
rows.values: Never / ControlStatements / ControlStatementsExceptControlMacros / NonEmptyParentheses / Always / Custom
rows.description: 左圆括号前的空格规则。
rows.originalDescription: Defines in which cases to put a space before opening parentheses.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions
rows.values: JSON 对象；兼容形式以插件校验为准。
rows.description: SpaceBeforeParens=Custom 时的具体空格规则。
rows.originalDescription: Control of individual space before parentheses.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterControlStatements
rows.description: 控制流关键字之后、左圆括号之前加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: 控制流关键字之后、左圆括号之前加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterForeachMacros
rows.description: 循环宏之后加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: 循环宏之后加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterFunctionDeclarationName
rows.description: 函数声明名与左圆括号之间加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: 函数声明名与左圆括号之间加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterFunctionDefinitionName
rows.description: 函数定义名与左圆括号之间加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterIfMacros
rows.description: if 宏之后加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterNot
rows.description: not 关键字之后、左圆括号之前加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: not 关键字之后、左圆括号之前加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterOverloadedOperator
rows.description: 重载运算符与左圆括号之间加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterPlacementOperator
rows.description: placement new/delete 与左圆括号之间加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: placement new/delete 与左圆括号之间加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.AfterRequiresInClause
rows.description: requires 子句关键字与左圆括号之间加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: requires 子句关键字与左圆括号之间加入空格。

rows.description: requires 表达式关键字与左圆括号之间加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeParensOptions.BeforeNonEmptyParentheses
rows.description: 非空圆括号之前加入空格。
rows.originalDescription: 非空圆括号之前加入空格。

rows.name: SpaceBeforeRangeBasedForLoopColon
rows.description: 是否在范围 for 的冒号之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If false, spaces will be removed before range-based for loop colon.

rows.name: SpaceBeforeSquareBrackets
rows.description: 是否在方括号之前添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, spaces will be before [. Lambdas will not be affected. Only the first [ will get a space added.

rows.name: SpaceInEmptyBlock
rows.description: 是否在空代码块花括号内保留空格。
rows.originalDescription: This option is **deprecated**. See Block of SpaceInEmptyBraces.

rows.name: SpaceInEmptyBraces
rows.description: 空花括号内部的空格规则。
rows.originalDescription: Specifies when to insert a space in empty braces.

rows.name: SpaceInEmptyParentheses
rows.description: 是否在空圆括号内部添加空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, spaces may be inserted into (). This option is **deprecated**. See InEmptyParentheses of SpacesInParensOptions.

rows.name: SpacesBeforeTrailingComments
rows.description: 代码与行尾注释之间至少保留的空格数。
rows.originalDescription: The number of spaces before trailing line comments (// - comments).

rows.name: SpacesInAngles
rows.description: 尖括号内部的空格规则。
rows.originalDescription: The SpacesInAnglesStyle to use for template argument lists.

rows.name: SpacesInCStyleCastParentheses
rows.description: 控制C 风格类型转换圆括号内部的空格。
rows.originalDescription: If true, spaces may be inserted into C style casts. This option is **deprecated**. See InCStyleCasts of SpacesInParensOptions.

rows.name: SpacesInConditionalStatement
rows.description: 控制控制条件括号内部的空格。

rows.name: SpacesInContainerLiterals

rows.name: SpacesInLineCommentPrefix

rows.name: SpacesInParensOptions.InCStyleCasts

rows.description: 控制圆括号内部的空格。

rows.name: SpacesInSquareBrackets
rows.description: 控制方括号内部的空格。

rows.name: Standard
rows.description: 影响格式化语法判断的语言标准。

rows.name: TabWidth

rows.originalDescription: The number of columns used for tab stops.

rows.name: TableGenBreakInsideDAGArg
